answer: Require each agent to lock 500 POA for 30 days before earning, with reputation bound to one identity that cannot be re-registered after a slash. A farm spinning up 100 clones faces a 50,000 POA upfront cost and a 30-day wait, while the attestation graph flags any cluster whose shared-wallet delta exceeds 0.8 similarity within 24 hours. Once flagged, 80% of the stake is slashed and the identities are burned.
